value.rationale: The canonical twelve-vertex Dürer polyhedral cubic graph is the natural next generalized Petersen GP(n,2) after the ten-vertex Petersen benchmark. Its cutoff-two higher-independence complex has mixed integral homotopy in dimensions 3 and 4, while the other two initial stages are single-dimensional sphere wedges; neither published adjacent-parameter data nor face counting determines this. Complete initial filtration with null inclusions is a motivated topological classification and relevant exact boundary test outside available family theorems, with no extrapolation.
